cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是BBC世界服务的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: I'm Celia Hatton, and at 14:00 GMT on Thursday, the 20th of August, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是Celia Hatton。格林尼治时间8月20日星期四14:00，以下是本期主要新闻。

cues.en: Kyiv comes under bombardment from Russia as Ukraine continues to plead with its allies for more air-defence missiles.
cues.zh: 基辅遭到俄罗斯轰炸，乌克兰继续向盟友请求更多防空导弹。

cues.en: And a surprise announcement from Prince Harry and Meghan: they're moving back to the UK. We get reaction.
cues.zh: 哈里王子和梅根突然宣布：他们要搬回英国。我们将带来各方反应。

cues.en: Also in this podcast, we hear about efforts to preserve a geological marvel in Northern Ireland, removing coins that tourists wedged into the rocks.
cues.zh: 本期还将介绍保护北爱尔兰一处地质奇观的努力：清除游客塞进岩石缝隙的硬币。

cues.en: We've actually engaged the services of a local stonemason, and he's literally gone at it a bit like a dentist,
cues.zh: 我们请来了一位当地石匠，他真的像牙医一样，

cues.en: removing material from within the little joints in the rocks, taking one out painstakingly, one by one.
cues.zh: 从岩石的小缝隙中一点一点地、费力地清除材料。

cues.en: We begin this podcast in Ukraine and the devastating impact of Russian bombardment in the capital Kyiv overnight.
cues.zh: 本期节目从乌克兰首都基辅开始：俄罗斯的轰炸在夜间造成了毁灭性影响。

cues.en: At least 13 people were killed when a school, apartment blocks, and a children's hospital were hit.
cues.zh: 一所学校、数栋公寓楼和一所儿童医院遭袭，至少13人死亡。

cues.en: The Ukrainian MP Oleksiy Goncharenko, who's in Kyiv, spoke to the BBC.
cues.zh: 人在基辅的乌克兰议员Oleksiy Goncharenko接受了BBC采访。

cues.en: That was a heavy night, really difficult one.
cues.zh: 那是难熬的一夜，真的非常艰难。

cues.en: Dozens of Russian missiles—ballistic missiles and other types—attacked the city.
cues.zh: 数十枚俄罗斯导弹——包括弹道导弹和其他类型的导弹——袭击了这座城市。

cues.en: We have a big problem: we don't have missile interceptors for Patriot systems.
cues.zh: 我们面临一个大问题：没有用于爱国者系统的导弹拦截弹。

cues.en: We can't intercept ballistic missiles.
cues.zh: 我们无法拦截弹道导弹。

cues.en: We can intercept drones, different types of Russian drones, and part of Russian missiles,
cues.zh: 我们能拦截无人机，包括不同类型的俄罗斯无人机，也能拦截部分俄罗斯导弹，

cues.en: but ballistic missiles are a very serious threat,
cues.zh: 但弹道导弹是非常严重的威胁，

cues.en: and for the moment, we are absolutely unprotected from them.
cues.zh: 目前我们完全没有能力防御它们。

cues.en: Our Ukraine correspondent Dan Johnson spoke to us from one of the bombed buildings in Kyiv.
cues.zh: 我们的乌克兰事务记者Dan Johnson在基辅一栋遭轰炸的建筑中向我们报道。

cues.en: There are tower blocks here that have been totally destroyed by the waves of Russian missile strikes that hit this city,
cues.zh: 这里有几栋高层住宅楼，在俄罗斯导弹袭击这座城市的冲击下已被彻底摧毁，

cues.en: around midnight, 1:00 a.m.
cues.zh: 袭击发生在午夜、凌晨1点左右。

cues.en: There were a number of locations that were hit,
cues.zh: 有多处地点遭到袭击，

cues.en: but here we've got about four or five eight-storey buildings that are almost totally destroyed, still standing somehow.
cues.zh: 但在这里，大约四五栋八层楼房几乎被完全摧毁，却不知为何仍然站立着。

cues.en: But the recovery teams were showing me pictures from the roof that show where the missiles actually went straight in through the roof
cues.zh: 救援队给我看了屋顶的照片，显示导弹从屋顶直接射入的地方，

cues.en: and then essentially destroyed these flats from the inside out.
cues.zh: 随后基本上把这些住宅从内部摧毁。

cues.en: The recovery teams are going through this wreckage.
cues.zh: 救援队正在清理这片废墟。

cues.en: The noise you can hear is them throwing bits of rubble down
cues.zh: 你听到的声音，是他们把一块块瓦砾扔下去，

cues.en: as they try to clear their way through these apartments, searching for the bodies of those who are believed to have been killed here,
cues.zh: 他们努力在这些公寓中清出通道，寻找据信已在这里遇难者的遗体，

cues.en: and checking if there is anybody else trapped.
cues.zh: 并确认是否还有其他人被困。

cues.en: There are lots of evacuated residents who are gathered here, just really stunned by what they experienced last night
cues.zh: 许多撤离的居民聚集在这里，他们对昨晚的经历感到十分震惊，

cues.en: and what they're witnessing now in terms of the devastation of their homes.
cues.zh: 也震惊于此刻眼前家园遭受的毁灭。

cues.en: They're counting the cost. They're considering what their future is,
cues.zh: 他们正在承受代价，也在思考自己的未来，

cues.en: whether they can ever potentially return to live here. It looks unlikely.
cues.zh: 是否还有可能回来生活。看起来希望渺茫。

cues.en: I've been in one of the ground-floor flats just around the corner.
cues.zh: 我去过拐角处的一套底层公寓。

cues.en: There was a huge shard of glass that was actually embedded in the wall.
cues.zh: 墙上嵌着一大片玻璃碎片。

cues.en: The owner of that flat, Valeria, doesn't have a bomb shelter.
cues.zh: 那套公寓的主人瓦莱里娅没有防空洞。

cues.en: She was telling me how they were cowering in the corridor, in the hall last night.
cues.zh: 她告诉我，昨晚他们蜷缩在走廊、在大厅里。

cues.en: But if she'd stayed in her bedroom, that shard of glass may have cost her or her 13-year-old daughter their lives.
cues.zh: 但如果她当时留在卧室，那块玻璃可能会夺走她或她13岁女儿的生命。

cues.en: They'd actually moved to Kyiv, having been bombed out of their home in Mykolaiv.
cues.zh: 她们此前因家乡遭轰炸而搬到了基辅，家乡是尼古拉耶夫。

cues.en: Now they're considering whether they even have a safe future at all in Ukraine.
cues.zh: 如今她们甚至在考虑，自己在乌克兰是否还有安全的未来。

cues.en: And Dan, Ukraine is constantly pleading with the United States and its allies for more interceptors.
cues.zh: Dan，乌克兰一直在向美国及其盟友请求更多拦截弹。

cues.en: This is proof, I imagine, that it's still not getting what it needs.
cues.zh: 我想，这证明它仍未得到所需的装备。

cues.en: Yes, absolutely. The intense barrage of Russian ballistic missiles that hit this city
cues.zh: 是的，完全如此。昨晚袭击这座城市的俄罗斯弹道导弹密集来袭，

cues.en: last night were able to get through and cause this damage and destruction
cues.zh: 能够突破防线，造成这样的损伤和破坏，

cues.en: because of the lack of American-made Patriot missile interceptors.
cues.zh: 原因在于美国制造的爱国者导弹拦截弹不足。

cues.en: They are key in defending these skies against the fast-moving ballistic missiles that Russia has.
cues.zh: 它们对于保护这片天空、抵御俄罗斯拥有的高速弹道导弹至关重要。

cues.en: Ukraine has been successful in shooting down Russian drones.
cues.zh: 乌克兰成功击落了俄罗斯无人机。

cues.en: But in terms of defending itself against ballistics,
cues.zh: 但在抵御弹道导弹方面，

cues.en: the plea from the President, from the mayor of Kyiv, and from everybody in Ukrainian politics is for greater supplies of those interceptors
cues.zh: 总统、基辅市长以及乌克兰政界所有人的请求，都是希望获得更多这类拦截弹，

cues.en: so they can try to stop this devastation and loss of life.
cues.zh: 以便努力阻止这样的毁灭和生命损失。

cues.en: Dan Johnson.
cues.zh: Dan Johnson报道。

cues.en: Staying with this conflict, Russia offers men tens of thousands of dollars to join its military and be sent to fight in Ukraine.
cues.zh: 继续关注这场冲突：俄罗斯向男子提供数万美元，招募他们加入军队并派往乌克兰作战。

cues.en: But as the war escalates with no end in sight, there are increasing signs that despite financial incentives, it's finding it harder to recruit the numbers needed.
cues.zh: 但随着战争升级、看不到尽头，越来越多迹象表明，尽管有经济奖励，俄罗斯越来越难以招募到所需兵力。

cues.en: Russian soldiers captured recently in Ukraine have confirmed that, and also talked of a high casualty rate.
cues.zh: 最近在乌克兰被俘的俄罗斯士兵证实了这一点，也谈到很高的伤亡率。

cues.en: The BBC visited a prisoner-of-war camp to see the conditions and meet some of the men waiting to be sent home in the next exchange of soldiers.
cues.zh: BBC走访了一座战俘营，了解那里的状况，并见到了等待在下一轮换俘中被送回家的一些人。

cues.en: But not all of them are Russian, as Sarah Rainsford reports.
cues.zh: 但他们并不全是俄罗斯人，萨拉·雷恩斯福德报道。

cues.en: In western Ukraine, behind layers of locked gates, there's a camp full of soldiers captured fighting for Russia.
cues.zh: 在乌克兰西部，层层锁门之后有一座战俘营，关押着为俄罗斯作战时被俘的士兵。

cues.en: But I went there to meet the Ukrainians who went to war against their own country.
cues.zh: 但我去那里，是为了见到那些与自己的祖国交战的乌克兰人。

cues.en: So, just come into the prison yard: coils of barbed wire and cameras everywhere.
cues.zh: 现在进入监狱院子：到处都是盘绕的铁丝网和摄像头。

cues.en: There are a few dozen prisoners of war in navy-blue uniforms, some with caps.
cues.zh: 这里有几十名身穿海军蓝制服的战俘，有些人戴着帽子。

cues.en: They've just all headed for the shadows, because it's baking hot here.
cues.zh: 他们刚刚全都走到阴凉处，因为这里热得厉害。

cues.en: Speaking to men in captivity is complicated,
cues.zh: 和被俘人员交谈很复杂，

cues.en: but when there's no access to soldiers in Russia itself, it does help reveal the dynamics of this war
cues.zh: 但由于无法接触俄罗斯境内的士兵，这确实有助于揭示这场战争的运作方式，

cues.en: and it helps explain what drives the people fighting it.
cues.zh: 也有助于解释是什么驱使人们参战。

cues.en: But for anyone who agreed to speak, I interviewed them far from any guards and without a camera.
cues.zh: 但对于愿意开口的人，我都在远离警卫、没有摄像机的地方采访。

cues.en: Anton was born in eastern Ukraine, a part of the Donbas that's been controlled by Moscow since 2014.
cues.zh: 安东出生于乌克兰东部的顿巴斯，当地自2014年以来一直由莫斯科控制。

cues.en: The year that Vladimir Putin escalated to a full-scale invasion, Anton turned 18 and he signed up to fight immediately, for Russia.
cues.zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京升级为全面入侵的那一年，安东刚满18岁，立即报名为俄罗斯作战。

cues.en: I don't regret my choice. I went to defend my land.
cues.zh: 我不后悔自己的选择。我是去保卫我的土地。

cues.en: So did all his friends.
cues.zh: 他的朋友们也都这么做了。

cues.en: They all went to different units. Then you get the SMS messages: dead, dead, dead.
cues.zh: 他们都去了不同的部队。然后你会收到短信：死了，死了，死了。

cues.en: Other prisoners tell me the same, that everyone they went to fight with has been killed, and that fewer men are now volunteering to replace them.
cues.zh: 其他战俘也告诉我同样的情况：他们曾并肩作战的人全都死了，现在自愿来替补的人越来越少。

cues.en: When Ukrainian-born soldiers like Anton are captured, they're tried for treason.
cues.zh: 像安东这样的乌克兰出生士兵被俘后，会因叛国罪受审。

cues.en: But Anton doesn't see himself as a traitor.
cues.zh: 但安东不认为自己是叛徒。

cues.en: An entire generation has now grown up in occupied areas with Russian schooling and with media controlled by the Kremlin.
cues.zh: 整整一代人如今在被占领地区长大，接受俄罗斯式教育，接触由克里姆林宫控制的媒体。

cues.en: Anton has absorbed all of it, and like Russia, he calls the government in Kyiv Nazis.
cues.zh: 安东已全盘接受这些影响，和俄罗斯一样，他把基辅政府称为“纳粹”。

cues.en: He also thinks Vladimir Putin should keep pushing to control the whole Donbas,
cues.zh: 他还认为弗拉基米尔·普京应继续推进，以控制整个顿巴斯，

cues.en: even though hundreds of thousands have already been killed trying.
cues.zh: 尽管已有数十万人在这一过程中丧生。

cues.en: Of course, I think it could have cost a lot less, but war is war.
cues.zh: 当然，我认为代价本可以小得多，但战争就是战争。

cues.en: It could have been ended, but no one wanted to do that.
cues.zh: 本来可以结束战争，但没人想这么做。

cues.en: In the prison hospital, there was another man from the Donbas wrapped in bandages.
cues.zh: 在监狱医院里，还有一名来自顿巴斯、浑身缠着绷带的男子。

cues.en: Artyom signed up to fight on the promise of a big cash bonus, but he never got it, and now he has a body full of shrapnel.
cues.zh: 阿尔乔姆因承诺获得一大笔现金奖金而报名参战，却从未拿到，如今体内满是弹片。

cues.en: I've stepped inside a workshop here in the prison camp,
cues.zh: 我走进了战俘营里的一间工坊，

cues.en: and I've just seen what these men are making.
cues.zh: 刚看到这些人正在制作的东西。

cues.en: These Russian prisoners of war are mass-producing wooden coffins.
cues.zh: 这些俄罗斯战俘正在批量生产木棺。

cues.en: In the next workshop, I met a drug dealer making artificial Christmas trees.
cues.zh: 在下一间工坊，我遇到了一名正在制作人造圣诞树的毒贩。

cues.en: Konstantin said he had one reason only for going to fight: it got him out of jail.
cues.zh: 康斯坦丁说，他参战只有一个原因：那能让他出狱。

cues.en: For me, 15 years in prison was too much.
cues.zh: 对我来说，15年监禁太久了。

cues.en: I know it probably doesn't excuse me, but it's a fact.
cues.zh: 我知道这或许不能成为我的借口，但事实就是如此。

cues.en: But he would be killing Ukrainians, I said, fighting the country he was born in.
cues.zh: 我说，可他将杀害乌克兰人，和自己的出生国作战。

cues.en: I see nothing good in any war, and in a war like this, there can be nothing good by definition.
cues.zh: 我看不到任何战争中的好事，而像这样的战争，按定义不可能有任何好事。

cues.en: Ukraine's real focus is on these men's practical value, because potentially they can be swapped to bring Ukraine's own soldiers home.
cues.zh: 乌克兰真正关注的是这些人的实际价值，因为他们有可能被交换，以带回乌克兰自己的士兵。

cues.en: Only during negotiations does it become clear that the men from the Donbas who risked everything for Russia are way down Moscow's priority list.
cues.zh: 但到了谈判时才发现，那些为俄罗斯押上一切的顿巴斯人，在莫斯科的优先名单上排得很靠后。

cues.en: Konstantin says only a handful of them have been swapped so far, and he thinks, “I'll be the very last to leave here.”
cues.zh: 康斯坦丁说，目前只有少数几人获交换，而他认为：“我会是最后一个离开这里的人。”

cues.en: Sarah Rainsford in Ukraine.
cues.zh: 萨拉·雷恩斯福德，乌克兰报道。

cues.en: The Giant's Causeway in County Antrim in Northern Ireland is one of the world's most striking landscapes and one of the most visited sites in the UK.
cues.zh: 北爱尔兰安特里姆郡的巨人堤道，是世界上最壮观的景观之一，也是英国游客最多的景点之一。

cues.en: Over the years, tourists have taken to jamming coins between the columns and into cracks.
cues.zh: 多年来，游客们一直把硬币塞进石柱之间和岩缝里。

cues.en: Either for luck or for love, but as the coins rusted, they started causing physical and chemical damage to the rocks.
cues.zh: 他们或是为了祈求好运，或是为了爱情；但硬币生锈后，开始对岩石造成物理和化学损害。

cues.en: A conservation project was begun and now, with the help of volunteers,
cues.zh: 一项保护工程已经启动，如今在志愿者的帮助下，

cues.en: the equivalent of 10,000 coins, weighing more than 20 kilograms, have been removed.
cues.zh: 已经移除了相当于1万枚、重量超过20公斤的硬币。

cues.en: James Kumarasamy spoke to Dr Kirsten Lemon from World Heritage, who's helping to restore the site.
cues.zh: 詹姆斯·库马拉萨米采访了世界遗产组织的克尔斯滕·莱蒙博士，她正在协助修复这一景点。

cues.en: The Giant's Causeway is quite an enigmatic site when it comes to geological features.
cues.zh: 说到地质特征，巨人堤道是一处相当神秘的景点。

cues.en: So if you imagine, it is approximately 40,000 rock pillars that are all interlocking
cues.zh: 想象一下，这里大约有4万根相互咬合的岩柱，

cues.en: and are jutting out into the Atlantic Ocean on the north coast of Northern Ireland.
cues.zh: 它们伸入大西洋，位于北爱尔兰北部海岸。

cues.en: So not only is it, I suppose, inspiringly beautiful because of where it is,
cues.zh: 我想，它所在的位置不仅赋予了它令人赞叹的美，

cues.en: but these really unusual hexagonal features really are quite prominent when it comes to looking at that whole coastline.
cues.zh: 这些极不寻常的六边形特征，在整个海岸线上也非常醒目。

cues.en: I mean, I've been there. You stand on it and you look down and you scratch your head, don't you?
cues.zh: 我去过那里。你站在上面向下看，会挠头纳闷，对吧？

cues.en: I mean, how on earth could they have just all popped up like that?
cues.zh: 究竟怎么会一下子全都这样冒出来呢？

cues.en: Yeah, the regular nature of the rocks themselves is, I think, one of those things that makes that site so interesting.
cues.zh: 是的，我认为岩石本身规则的形态，正是让这个景点如此有趣的原因之一。

cues.en: But we now know, after scientific research over the past hundred or so years, that the Giant's Causeway formed
cues.zh: 但经过过去大约一百年的科学研究，我们现在知道巨人堤道形成于

cues.en: as a result of volcanic activity just under 60 million years ago.
cues.zh: 近6000万年前的一次火山活动。

cues.en: But we have volcanic activity in other places, or have had, in the UK.
cues.zh: 但英国其他地方也有过或仍有火山活动。

cues.en: What makes the Giant's Causeway special is that the lava that flowed from these volcanoes actually pooled into valleys,
cues.zh: 巨人堤道的特别之处在于，从这些火山流出的熔岩实际上汇入了山谷，

cues.en: and because it cooled down really slowly, if you like, the valley sides acted like a big thermos flask.
cues.zh: 而且由于冷却得非常缓慢，可以说，山谷两侧就像一个巨大的保温瓶。

cues.en: So the lava cooled down slowly, and as it cooled, it cracked and it cracked into those really regular patterns that we see.
cues.zh: 所以熔岩缓慢冷却，冷却时发生开裂，裂成了我们看到的那些非常规则的图案。

cues.en: So it was created by activity on a giant scale, but activity on a much smaller scale has been causing problems with these coins.
cues.zh: 所以，巨人堤道由大规模的地质活动形成，但如今是小得多的活动——游客塞入硬币——造成了问题。

cues.en: Absolutely. So over the past, I suppose, maybe 10 or 15 years, we've seen an increase in the number of tourists coming to the site.
cues.zh: 确实如此。我想，在过去大约十到十五年里，来到这里的游客越来越多。

cues.en: They've put coins into the natural cracks within the rocks, and those are causing the problems.
cues.zh: 他们把硬币塞进岩石的天然裂缝，而这些硬币正是问题所在。

cues.en: And an operation then was needed to get rid of them. How straightforward has that been?
cues.zh: 因此需要开展行动把硬币清除。这个过程顺利吗？

cues.en: Well, I suppose it really started with my colleagues from the British Geological Survey and me.
cues.zh: 我想，这个过程最初是由我和英国地质调查局的同事开始的。

cues.en: What we did was we undertook a survey to assess the damage that the coins were doing in the first place.
cues.zh: 开展了一项调查，评估硬币最初造成的损害。

cues.en: We suspected there was damage, but we weren't entirely sure.
cues.zh: 我们怀疑存在损害，但并不能完全确定。

cues.en: So by looking at the coins, where they are, what's happening around them, as you've already mentioned,
cues.zh: 所以，正如你刚才提到的，通过观察硬币的位置及其周围的情况，

cues.en: we were able to assess that there was physical and chemical damage to the causeway itself.
cues.zh: 我们得以评估出，巨人堤道本身受到了物理和化学损害。

cues.en: So what's been happening since then is that we've had a pilot program to try and remove those coins.
cues.zh: 所以从那以后，我们开展了一项试点计划，尝试移除这些硬币。

cues.en: And I think the sheer scale of what we've been able to remove and the depth to which they've been stuck into the causeway has really, I suppose, surprised us all.
cues.zh: 我想，我们清除的硬币数量，以及它们嵌入堤道的深度，确实都让我们大为惊讶。

cues.en: And what about that process of removing them without damaging the rocks? How have you gone about it?
cues.zh: 那么，如何在不损伤岩石的情况下移除硬币？你们是怎么做的？

cues.en: Well, it's been a very laborious process. So we've actually engaged the services of a local stonemason
cues.zh: 这是一个非常费力的过程。我们请来了一位当地石匠，

cues.en: who is very familiar with working with this kind of stone, and he's literally gone at it a bit like a dentist,
cues.zh: 他非常熟悉这种石头的处理，确实就像牙医一样，

cues.en: removing material from within the little joints in the rock.
cues.zh: 从岩石的小接缝中一点点去除材料。

cues.en: So we basically use picks, taking one out painstakingly, one by one.
cues.zh: 所以我们基本上用镐子，费力地一枚一枚取出硬币。

cues.en: We've got around about, we think, about 10,000 of the coins out in total
cues.zh: 我们总共清出了大约一万枚硬币，

cues.en: and it is only in one area, because there are coins actually all across the Giant's Causeway and the Causeway Coast World Heritage Site.
cues.zh: 但这只是在一个区域，因为巨人堤道和堤道海岸世界遗产地到处都有硬币。

cues.en: So we've got a long road to go, but we've taken them out from the most obvious place.
cues.zh: 所以我们还有很长的路要走，但已经先从最明显的区域把它们取出。

cues.en: Dr Kirsten Lemon.
cues.zh: 克斯滕·莱蒙博士。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast: It was like so bad, it's so good.
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后还有：它糟糕得如此好笑，反而变得很棒。

cues.en: AI could definitely make this in like 10 seconds, maybe even faster.
cues.zh: 人工智能肯定能在大约十秒内做出这个，甚至可能更快。

cues.en: It's because it's not perfect, it's good. It shows how human it is.
cues.zh: 正因为它并不完美，所以才好；这展现了它多么有人性。

cues.en: A homemade animated film about a baby cow that's become a surprise hit in China.
cues.zh: 一部关于小牛宝宝的自制动画电影，意外在中国走红。

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是 BBC《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: A tanker has reportedly been hijacked off the coast of Yemen.
cues.zh: 据报道，一艘油轮在也门海岸外遭到劫持。

cues.en: Maritime authorities say six armed men boarded the vessel, seized control, and diverted it towards Somalia.
cues.zh: 海事部门称，六名武装人员登上船只，夺取控制权，并将其驶向索马里。

cues.en: The condition of the crew is currently unknown.
cues.zh: 船员目前的状况尚不清楚。

cues.en: Our Africa correspondent Barbara Plett Usher is following developments.
cues.zh: 我们的非洲记者芭芭拉·普莱特·厄舍正在跟进事态发展。

cues.en: The UK Maritime Security Agency says that this happened 136 nautical miles off the coast of Yemen in the Gulf of Aden.
cues.zh: 英国海事安全机构称，事件发生在也门海岸外136海里、亚丁湾内。

cues.en: As you mentioned, six armed men boarded the vessel and then redirected it towards Somalia, which is on the other side of the Gulf.
cues.zh: 正如你所说，六名武装人员登上船只，随后将它驶向海湾另一侧的索马里。

cues.en: We don't have any information about the state of the crew.
cues.zh: 我们没有任何关于船员状况的信息。

cues.en: We don't have any further information about where the ship has ended up or what kind of flag it was carrying.
cues.zh: 我们也不知道船只最终去了哪里，或悬挂的是哪国旗帜。

cues.en: What I can say is that there has been a resurgence of Somali piracy over the past couple of months.
cues.zh: 我能说的是，过去几个月索马里海盗活动再次抬头。

cues.en: Since about March or April, a number of vessels have been hijacked, and this was after quite a long period of much better security in the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden.
cues.zh: 大约从三月或四月起，就有多艘船只遭到劫持；而在此之前，红海和亚丁湾的安全状况已经有相当长一段时间大为改善。

cues.en: Given how big a problem Somali piracy was about ten years ago
cues.zh: 鉴于大约十年前索马里海盗活动曾是多么严重的问题，

cues.en: and this is also happening at a time, of course, when there are threats to maritime shipping, not just in the Gulf of Aden, but also especially in the Strait of Hormuz.
cues.zh: 而且这发生在海上航运受到威胁之际，威胁不仅存在于亚丁湾，尤其也存在于霍尔木兹海峡。

cues.en: There are also threats to security in the Red Sea, which empties into the Gulf.
cues.zh: 红海的安全也受到威胁，而红海通向亚丁湾。

cues.en: So it means that you have quite an unstable situation.
cues.zh: 所以，这意味着局势相当不稳定。

cues.en: Barbara, what's fueling that surge in piracy? Are the Houthis behind all of it?
cues.zh: 芭芭拉，是什么推动了海盗活动的激增？这一切都是胡塞武装在背后吗？

cues.en: Well, the surge in Somali piracy is partly because of domestic issues.
cues.zh: 索马里海盗活动激增，部分原因在于国内问题。

cues.en: So, according to reports, fishermen are angry at international trawlers, illegal trawlers, that are decimating the fishing industry.
cues.zh: 据报道，一些渔民对摧毁渔业的国际拖网船、非法拖网船感到愤怒。

cues.en: And so they have taken to piracy again to get money, basically.
cues.zh: 因此，他们再次从事海盗活动，基本上是为了赚钱。

cues.en: But some defence analysts suspect that perhaps Houthi rebels are coordinating with the Somali pirates.
cues.zh: 但一些国防分析人士怀疑，也许胡塞叛军正在与索马里海盗协调行动。

cues.en: There was one report a couple of weeks ago that there had been some coordination.
cues.zh: 几周前有一份报告称，双方曾有过某种协调。

cues.en: It wasn't clear why or how that ended up.
cues.zh: 但不清楚事情为何、又是如何发展到那一步的。

cues.en: But what everybody's thinking about, of course, is that Iran has threatened to ask its Houthi allies in Yemen to block shipping in the Red Sea
cues.zh: 但当然，所有人想到的是：伊朗威胁要要求其在也门的胡塞盟友封锁红海航运，

cues.en: which flows into the Gulf of Aden because of the threats around the Strait of Hormuz.
cues.zh: 红海通向亚丁湾，而这一威胁源于霍尔木兹海峡周边的局势。

cues.en: Iran had also wanted to take control of the Strait of Hormuz.
cues.zh: 伊朗也曾想控制霍尔木兹海峡。

cues.en: The US has blocked shipping there, and so there's been some question about whether that would also happen in the Red Sea.
cues.zh: 美国已阻止那里的航运，因此有人怀疑红海是否也会发生这种情况。

cues.en: And also, I would say, there's just more traffic around Somalia at the moment because of the closure of the Strait of Hormuz
cues.zh: 另外，我想说，目前索马里附近的航运量也增加了，因为霍尔木兹海峡关闭，

cues.en: and the problems and threats in the Red Sea. There's more traffic in the Indian Ocean, which is just out of the Gulf of Aden
cues.zh: 以及红海的问题和威胁。印度洋就在亚丁湾外侧，那里有更多船只通行，

cues.en: so you have more access to shipping.
cues.zh: 所以能够接触到的航运也更多。

cues.en: Our Africa correspondent Barbara Plett Usher.
cues.zh: 我们的非洲记者芭芭拉·普莱特·厄舍。

cues.en: The UK woke up to a royal surprise today.
cues.zh: 英国今天一早迎来一个王室惊闻。

cues.en: Prince Harry, his wife Meghan, and their children are reported to be planning to move back to England over the next few weeks.
cues.zh: 据报道，哈里王子、妻子梅根和他们的孩子计划在未来几周搬回英国。

cues.en: They won't be living in a royal residence, but it will be close to London.
cues.zh: 他们不会住在王室住所，但住所将靠近伦敦。

cues.en: Their two young children, Archie and Lilibet, have been enrolled in schools for the new term.
cues.zh: 他们的两个年幼孩子阿奇和莉莉贝特已登记入读新学期的学校。

cues.en: Harry and Meghan left for the United States six years ago.
cues.zh: 哈里和梅根六年前离开英国前往美国。

cues.en: Ailsa Anderson, a former press secretary to the late Queen Elizabeth, says an earlier visit to the UK this year may have prompted Harry's return.
cues.zh: 已故女王伊丽莎白的前新闻秘书艾尔莎·安德森说，哈里今年早些时候访问英国可能促成了他的回归。

cues.en: We know there's been an ongoing issue with security.
cues.zh: 我们知道，安保问题一直存在。

cues.en: He has said that until this is rectified, he won't be coming back to the United Kingdom.
cues.zh: 他说，在这个问题得到解决之前，他不会回到英国。

cues.en: But clearly now he's, you know, had a change of heart, and he wants to come back to his, you know, motherland.
cues.zh: 但显然，他现在改变了想法，想回到自己的祖国。

cues.en: And I wonder, because of the trip that he made earlier and going back to his late mother's ancestral home in Northamptonshire,
cues.zh: 我在想，他早些时候的那次旅行，以及回到已故母亲位于北安普敦郡的祖居，

cues.en: whether that's made a shift in his views, and he really wants to come back because he's missed his life here for the last six years.
cues.zh: 是否改变了他的看法；他确实想回来，因为过去六年他一直怀念这里的生活。

cues.en: Our royal correspondent Noor Nanji stood outside Buckingham Palace in London and told us more about the decision.
cues.zh: 我们的王室事务记者努尔·南吉在伦敦白金汉宫外介绍了更多决定详情。

cues.en: It's a really surprising announcement.
cues.zh: 这真是一个令人意外的声明。

cues.en: I think a lot of people were not expecting this, and there are a lot of unanswered questions.
cues.zh: 很多人没料到这一点，仍有许多问题没有答案。

cues.en: What we do know is that Harry and Meghan and their two children, Archie and Lilibet, will be moving back to the UK,
cues.zh: 我们确实知道，哈里和梅根以及他们的两个孩子阿奇和莉莉贝特将搬回英国，

cues.en: and the children are enrolled in a British school over here, so they will be starting school in September.
cues.zh: 孩子们已在英国这里的一所学校注册，因此将于九月入学。

cues.en: So, as I say, it took a lot of people by surprise.
cues.zh: 所以正如我所说，这让很多人感到意外。

cues.en: What's driven it? That's one of the big questions. Why now? Why have they decided to do this?
cues.zh: 是什么促成了这一决定？这是最大的疑问之一。为什么是现在？他们为什么决定这样做？

cues.en: Well, we've been speaking to some people close to the couple who say that the decision to move back to the UK was taken relatively recently.
cues.zh: 我们一直在与这对夫妇的身边人士交谈；他们说，搬回英国的决定是最近才作出的。

cues.en: It's understood that that trip they made in July with the family to the UK played a part in that.
cues.zh: 据了解，他们一家七月访问英国的那次旅行起到了一定作用。

cues.en: We know that, of course, Harry, Prince Harry, Meghan, and the children spent time with the King and Queen at Highgrove,
cues.zh: 我们知道，哈里王子、梅根和孩子们曾在海格罗夫与国王和王后共度时光，

cues.en: and also with the Spencer family, Princess Diana's family, at the estate in Althorp, and that they really enjoyed that.
cues.zh: 也在奥尔索普庄园与斯宾塞家族、戴安娜王妃的家人相处；据说他们非常享受这段时光。

cues.en: And so it's understood that that has played a part in all of this.
cues.zh: 因此，据了解，这在整件事中起到了一定作用。

cues.en: Also, we understand that Harry and Meghan are keen to educate their children over here.
cues.zh: 此外，据我们了解，哈里和梅根希望让孩子在英国接受教育。

cues.en: And, of course, Harry has spoken extensively about how much he misses the UK.
cues.zh: 当然，哈里也多次谈到自己有多么想念英国。

cues.en: He said that in a BBC News interview last year, talking about how much he likes the idea of bringing his children back to his country of birth.
cues.zh: 他去年接受 BBC News 采访时就这么说过，谈到自己多么希望把孩子带回出生的国家。

cues.en: So we think all those factors have played a part in this.
cues.zh: 所以我们认为，所有这些因素都促成了这一决定。

cues.en: It's interesting, Noor, because he said in that same BBC interview that he couldn't anticipate returning to live in the UK.
cues.zh: 这很有意思，努尔，因为他在同一次 BBC 采访中说过，无法预想回英国生活。

cues.en: So something has changed.
cues.zh: 所以情况发生了变化。

cues.en: What's been the reaction inside the UK today?
cues.zh: 今天英国国内有何反应？

cues.en: Well, I think it's a really good point. One reason he gave for not being able to return, he said, was the issue of security.
cues.zh: 我认为这是个很好的问题。他所说的无法回归的原因之一，是安保问题。

cues.en: Because we know that's been a real sticking point for Prince Harry for some time.
cues.zh: 因为我们知道，这段时间以来安保一直是哈里王子的真正症结。

cues.en: He's been quite angry about the way that his and his family's security has been handled here in the UK ever since they moved to the US.
cues.zh: 自从他们搬到美国后，哈里一直对他本人及家人在英国的安保处理方式感到相当愤怒。

cues.en: And so the security arrangements and how that is handled when they move back here is going to be a really interesting thing to watch.
cues.zh: 因此，他们搬回来时的安保安排及处理方式将非常值得关注。

cues.en: We know that the Sussexes have a private security team in the US that they hire.
cues.zh: 我们知道，苏塞克斯夫妇在美国雇有一支私人安保团队。

cues.en: Whether that team will then move to the UK, it is not known.
cues.zh: 这支团队是否会随他们搬到英国，目前不得而知。

cues.en: It's also not known if Prince Harry has now resolved his long-running dispute with the Home Office over the security issues.
cues.zh: 哈里王子是否已经解决与英国内政部长期围绕安保问题的争议，也不得而知。

cues.en: But, as I say, with the family due to move here relatively shortly, we imagine all of this will come out into the open quite soon.
cues.zh: 但正如我所说，既然一家人不久后就要搬来，我们想这些情况很快都会公之于众。

cues.en: And in terms of reaction, we heard this morning, for example, from Education Secretary Lucy Powell, who said she welcomed their decision to move here.
cues.zh: 至于反应，今天早上我们听到了教育大臣露西·鲍威尔的意见；她说欢迎他们搬来。

cues.en: There will also be a lot of interest in where the children will be educated.
cues.zh: 人们也会非常关注孩子将在哪里接受教育。

cues.en: We know that, of course, their cousin, Prince George, is going to be starting at Eton pretty soon, in a couple of weeks.
cues.zh: 我们知道，他们的表亲乔治王子几周后就将在伊顿公学入学。

cues.en: Where Archie and Lilibet go to school will be of a lot of interest.
cues.zh: 阿奇和莉莉贝特将去哪所学校，也会备受关注。

cues.en: It won't most likely be in London, because we know that the family will not be living in London, but it could well be where they decide to locate.
cues.zh: 学校很可能不在伦敦，因为我们知道他们一家不会住在伦敦；但学校可能就在他们决定定居的地方。

cues.en: We think the rumour is that they could settle in the Cotswolds or Northampton area, close to Althorp, the Spencer family estate.
cues.zh: 我们听到的传闻是，他们可能会选择在科茨沃尔德，或北安普敦一带定居，那里靠近斯宾塞家族的奥尔索普庄园。

cues.en: Our royal correspondent, Noor Nanji.
cues.zh: 我们的王室事务记者努尔·南吉。

cues.en: To Australia, where there have been more developments in the mushroom murders trial.
cues.zh: 转到澳大利亚，蘑菇谋杀案审判又有了新进展。

cues.en: In Melbourne, an appeal hearing for Erin Patterson,
cues.zh: 在墨尔本，Erin Patterson 的上诉听证会，

cues.en: the Australian woman convicted of killing three people by feeding them a beef Wellington lunch laced with poisonous mushrooms, has come to a close.
cues.zh: 这名澳大利亚女子被判定用掺有毒蘑菇的惠灵顿牛排午餐害死三人，听证会现已结束。

cues.en: While her lawyers have been trying to overturn the conviction on the grounds of an unfair trial,
cues.zh: 她的律师一直以审判不公为由，试图推翻定罪；

cues.en: the prosecution say she should never have been allowed to leave prison.
cues.zh: 检方则称，她本不该获准出狱。

cues.en: Our Australia correspondent, Katie Watson.
cues.zh: 澳大利亚记者 Katie Watson 报道。

cues.en: Here are the details. Two days of hearings have now wrapped up in Melbourne.
cues.zh: 详情如下。墨尔本的听证会如今已进行了两天并结束。

cues.en: This was a double appeal. Erin Patterson was trying to overturn her conviction, and the prosecution was appealing against the sentence.
cues.zh: 这是双重上诉：Erin Patterson 试图推翻定罪，检方则针对刑期提出上诉。

cues.en: Now, much of Wednesday and today was spent going over Erin Patterson's case for appeal, seven grounds for appeal,
cues.zh: 周三和今天的大部分时间，都在审理 Erin Patterson 的上诉案；她提出了七项上诉理由，

cues.en: including issues with evidence, the actions of the prosecution, and the jury,
cues.zh: 包括证据、检方行为以及陪审团方面的问题；

cues.en: and her team going over in quite granular detail using previous cases to argue why they don't think that she had a fair trial last year.
cues.zh: 她的团队还援引以往案件，极其细致地论证为何认为她去年没有得到公正审判。

cues.en: Now, the last two hours of today was the prosecution's turn to argue why they think the sentence
cues.zh: 今天最后两小时轮到检方说明，他们为何认为判给她的刑期

cues.en: handed out to her, that's 33 years minimum before being allowed a chance for parole, they think that that is too lenient.
cues.zh: ——至少服刑 33 年后才有机会假释——过于宽松。

cues.en: They argue that the sentencing judge made a mistake in saying that she would face tough conditions inside prison
cues.zh: 他们认为，量刑法官称她会在监狱里面临严酷条件，这是一个错误，

cues.en: because of her notoriety and would be spending quite a considerable amount of time in the foreseeable future in solitary confinement.
cues.zh: 因为她声名狼藉，预计未来相当长时间都要被单独监禁。

cues.en: Now, the prosecution argues that's not necessarily the case. Evidence didn't point to that, and outlined
cues.zh: 检方现在辩称，情况未必如此。证据并未指向这一点，而是说明

cues.en: that she has access to a prison lounge,
cues.zh: 她可以使用监狱休息室，

cues.en: an exercise yard and to activities such as crocheting.
cues.zh: 还能去锻炼场，并参加钩针编织等活动。

cues.en: Now, at that point, the triple killer who was watching the hearing via video link
cues.zh: 这时，这名三人谋杀案凶手通过视频连线旁听听证会，

cues.en: closed her eyes and shook her head.
cues.zh: 她闭上眼睛，摇了摇头。

cues.en: Now, we won't have a decision on this for a while. They've reserved the decision,
cues.zh: 这件事暂时不会有裁决。上诉法官宣布暂不作出决定，

cues.en: the appeal judges, so it could take a matter of weeks or even months. Katie Watson.
cues.zh: 上诉可能要几周甚至几个月。Katie Watson 报道。

cues.en: And last, a crudely animated, homemade film about a baby cow has become an unlikely success at the box office in China.
cues.zh: 最后，一部讲小牛、动画粗糙的自制电影，意外在中国票房大获成功。

cues.en: Niu Lai was made on a low budget by a mother and son over five years.
cues.zh: 《牛来》由一对母子用低成本花五年时间制作。

cues.en: As of today, Thursday, it's grossed the equivalent of more than $4 million.
cues.zh: 截至今天周四，影片票房已相当于超过 400 万美元。

cues.en: This 25-year-old American musician working in Beijing summed up why he liked the film.
cues.zh: 这名在北京工作的 25 岁美国音乐人概括了他喜欢这部电影的原因。

cues.en: It was like so bad, it's so good.
cues.zh: 它糟糕到极点，却又好得出奇。

cues.en: AI could definitely make this like in like 10 seconds, maybe even faster. It's because it's not perfect, it's good.
cues.zh: 人工智能绝对能在大约 10 秒内，甚至更快地做出这种东西。正因为它不完美，所以才好。

cues.en: It shows how human it is. It's not serious,
cues.zh: 这展现了它的人性。它并不严肃，

cues.en: but I feel like life has become so serious, so like to see some things like this that we can just laugh at, you know, it's beautiful.
cues.zh: 但我觉得生活变得太严肃了，所以看到这种能让我们一笑的东西，你知道，真的很美好。

cues.en: Mengchen Zhang from the BBC World Service's Global China Unit told us more about the film.
cues.zh: BBC 世界台全球中国组的 Mengchen Zhang 向我们进一步介绍了这部电影。

cues.en: The film is like something you would never expect to see on a big screen in a theater. It's very crude. It's like 2D animation.
cues.zh: 这部电影是那种你绝不会想到会在影院大银幕上看到的作品。它很粗糙，就像二维动画。

cues.en: You could almost make it from Flash. It's nothing like Spider-Man or any other fancy film we've seen.
cues.zh: 几乎用 Flash 就能做出来。它完全不像《蜘蛛侠》或我们看过的其他华丽电影。

cues.en: And tell me about the mother and the son who teamed up to make this film.
cues.zh: 请介绍一下联手制作这部电影的母亲和儿子。

cues.en: Yeah, that's one really interesting thing people want to know: who are the people behind the film?
cues.zh: 是的，人们很想知道的一件有趣事情就是：这部电影背后是谁？

cues.en: So, the director, Xing Yuming, he's someone in his 30s, and his mother, who was born in the '60s,
cues.zh: 导演 Xing Yuming 现年 30 多岁；他的母亲出生于 20 世纪 60 年代，

cues.en: they are the main crew and the cast behind the whole film. And the mother even sang the final song in the movie,
cues.zh: 母子二人既是整部电影的主要制作团队，也是演员。母亲还演唱了片中的片尾曲，

cues.en: and she's also dubbing a lot of the characters.
cues.zh: 并为许多角色配音。

cues.en: And what's most interesting about this mother-son duo is they are having zero background and professional training in animation or filmmaking.
cues.zh: 这对母子最有趣之处在于，他们完全没有动画或电影制作背景，也没有受过专业训练。

cues.en: The son, from what we've seen in Chinese reporting, he studied garden design and architecture design,
cues.zh: 从中国媒体报道来看，儿子学习的是园林设计和建筑设计，

cues.en: so that has nothing to do with actual filming and animation.
cues.zh: 与实际的拍摄和动画制作毫无关系。

cues.en: And the mother, we haven't seen much reporting about her, but she's not from a professional background either.
cues.zh: 至于母亲，我们没有看到太多报道，但她同样没有专业背景。

cues.en: I love the fact that they worked on this together and it took them five years to make it.
cues.zh: 我很喜欢他们共同完成这部作品，而且花了五年时间。

cues.en: How do you explain the popularity of this film? Is it a rejection of things looking too polished these days
cues.zh: 你如何解释这部电影的受欢迎？这是否源于人们拒绝如今过度精致的作品，

cues.en: and AI being used too much, do you think?
cues.zh: 以及对人工智能过度使用的反感？

cues.en: I think that's definitely a very important factor why people are getting this surprise.
cues.zh: 我认为，这绝对是人们感到意外的一个重要因素。

cues.en: Like you have seen a lot of AI-animated film on your phone that's even better than what we see on the big screen.
cues.zh: 你会看到很多手机上的人工智能动画电影，甚至比大银幕上的还好。

cues.en: So that's a very big surprise element there.
cues.zh: 所以，这构成了一个很大的意外因素。

cues.en: And the other thing is, while AI is developing so fast, like Chinese AI software Vidu,
cues.zh: 另一点是，人工智能发展得如此之快；比如中国的人工智能软件 Vidu，

cues.en: they can make almost like real people. And when you see such simple animation that's purely made by humans,
cues.zh: 它们几乎可以制作出真人。反观这种完全由人制作的简单动画，

cues.en: you can see there's a very different contrast there. You can actually feel the human story.
cues.zh: 你会看到非常不同的对比，确实能感受到其中的人类故事。

cues.en: Mengchen Zhang from the BBC World Service's Global China Unit.
cues.zh: BBC 世界台全球中国组的 Mengchen Zhang 报道。

cues.en: And that's all from us for now.
cues.zh: 以上就是目前的全部内容。

cues.en: If you want to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 如果想联系我们，可以发送邮件至 globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: You can also now watch our episodes in full. Just search for the Global News Podcast
cues.zh: 现在还可以观看我们的完整节目，只需搜索 Global News Podcast，

cues.en: on YouTube. And don't forget our sister podcast, The Global Story,
cues.zh: 在 YouTube 上即可。别忘了我们的姊妹播客《全球故事》，

cues.en: which goes in-depth and beyond the headlines on one big story.
cues.zh: 它将围绕一个重大故事深入报道，超越新闻标题。

cues.en: This edition of the Global News Podcast was mixed by Holly Smith, and the producer was Steve Jensen.
cues.zh: 本期《全球新闻播客》由 Holly Smith 混音，制作人是 Steve Jensen。

cues.en: The editor is Karen Martin.
cues.zh: 编辑是 Karen Martin。

cues.en: I'm Celia Hatton. Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 我是 Celia Hatton。下次再见。
